entries.title: Psalms 133:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up. Of David.> See how good and how pleasing it is for brothers to be living together in harmony!

entries.title: Psalms 133:2
segments: It is like oil of great price on the head, flowing down over the face, even Aaron's face: coming down to the edge of his robe;

entries.title: Psalms 133:3
segments: Like the dew of Hermon, which comes down on the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord gave orders for the blessing, even life for ever.
